Name: Take A Break After Saving
Author: TeckieJo
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Get prompted to take a break immediately after the game saves. Configure how often and if you can skip it.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Displays a reminder screen to take breaks.[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Every morning (default)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Every Monday[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]After playing for an hour of real world time[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Can force the end of a play session after a configurable amount of real-world time.[/color]

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

The mod will disable itself in multi-player games.

At the moment the mod will hide notifications that would normally appear at the beginning of the day. (working on a fix)

[size=4][b]Note[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]AI usage: GitHub's Co-Pilot was used while making this mod.[/size][/color]
